scripts.db:prepare: node scripts/guard-not-production.mjs db:prepare && node scripts/wait-for-postgres.mjs && npm run db:push -w @c2k/api && npm run db:migrate-incremental -w @c2k/api && npm run db:seed -w @c2k/api && npm run db:ensure-preview-attendee-parity -w @c2k/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w @c2k/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @c2k/shared && npm run build -w @c2k/api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @c2k/shared && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w @c2k/api
